topic.title: Deploying Web Author in WebSphere Liberty (Deprecated)

body.note: Support for WebSphere Liberty was deprecated.
body.p: The following procedure provides an example of how to deploy in WebSphere Liberty:

ol.li: Download IBM WebSphere Liberty version 21.0.0.9. For details, see .
Extract the downloaded archive to a folder.
Open a command-line interface and navigate to that folder.
Run the following command: bin\server create
Place the .war file in the usr\servers\defaultServer\dropins folder.

Modify usr\servers\defaultServer\server.xml to include the following code: <server description="new server">
<!-- Enable features --> <featureManager> <feature>localConnector-1.0</feature> <feature>servlet-3.1</feature> <feature>websocket-1.1</feature> </featureManager> <!-- To access this server from a remote client add a host attribute to the following element, e.g. host="*" --> <httpEndpoint httpPort="9080" httpsPort="9443" id="defaultHttpEndpoint"/>
<!-- Automatically expand WAR files and EAR files --> <applicationManager autoExpand="true"/> <classloading useJarUrls="true"/> <httpSession cookieName="WEBSPHERE_JESSIONID"/>
<webContainer com.ibm.ws.webcontainer.initFilterBeforeInitServlet="true" com.ibm.ws.webcontainer.invokeFilterInitAtStartup="true" />
<applicationMonitor updateTrigger="mbean"/>
<keyStore id="defaultKeyStore" password="[keystore password]"/>
<basicRegistry id="basic" realm="BasicRealm"> </basicRegistry> </server>
Create a jvm.options file in [WEBSPHERE]\usr\servers\defaultServer\ with the following content:-Doxygen.data.dir=<path-to-wlp>\usr\servers\defaultServer\data
Run the following command to install all required components:bin\installUtility install defaultServerA proxy configuration might be needed to install the necessary components.

Optional: To create a proxy configuration for installing components:
Create a folder named 'etc' in the WebSphere root folder, then create a file named 'repositories.properties'.
In the repositories.properties file, add these lines:proxyHost=ip proxyPort=port
WebSphere deploys the application automatically. Check [WEBSPHERE]\usr\servers\defaultServer\logs\console.log.
In a command-line interface, run the following command:bin\server start --clean

ul.li: The application is deployed when the URL is first accessed (http://localhost:9080/oxygenxml-web-author/app/oxygen.html).
The Web Author log is available at <path-to-wlp>\usr\servers\defaultServer\data\logs\oxygen.log.
To view the server status, run: bin\server status.
To stop the server, run: bin\server stop.
